{{Top|leg}}
'''Containment field 776''' was a specific [[Containment field/Legends|containment field]] aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship]] ''[[Song of the Clouds]]''. It was used to protect a lockbox containing a [[Hapan]] [[Gun of Command]]. The [[Sluissi]] [[Hass Sonax]] managed to disable the containment field during a [[Heist on the Song of the Clouds|heist]] on the Herdship perpetrated by [[Cecil Noone]] and his [[Cecil Noone's crew|crew]] of [[Thief/Legends|thieves]].<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|The Great Herdship Heist}}</ref>
